entry.title: aws/aws-sdk-net - Releases - 2026-11-24
entry.content:
4.1.10.0

4.1.10.0 (2026-11-24 19:11 UTC)

  • BedrockAgentCore (4.1.3.0)
    • Adds the optional userLocation parameter to InvokeWebSearch. Specify a two-letter ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code to refine web search results for that country. InvokeWebSearch also accepts search queries in languages other than English.
  • GlobalAccelerator (4.1.0.3)
    • AWS Global Accelerator supports Client IP Preservation for NLBs with TLS Listener endpoints.
  • S3 (4.1.2.1)
    • Fixed GetPreSignedURL intermittently rejecting a 7 day expiry as over the SigV4 limit (#4604)

entry.title: Azure/azure-sdk-for-net - Releases - 2026-11-24
entry.content:
Azure.ResourceManager.NetApp_1.20.0-beta.2

1.20.0-beta.2 (2026-11-24)

Features Added

  • Upgraded the default service API version to 2026-09-01. Subvolume operations continue to use 2026-08-01 by default.

Breaking Changes

  • The 2026-09-01 service API no longer exposes the geographic namespace origin, asynchronous directory deletion, or bucket Key Vault user-assigned identity settings from 2026-08-15-preview.
  • The wire value of NetAppLdapServerType.OpenLdap is now OpenLdap rather than OpenLDAP, matching the service specification.

Other Changes

  • Marked the legacy subvolume types, operations, volume properties, and model factory overloads as obsolete. They remain callable for existing applications.
  • Marked the legacy Entra ID configuration models, account properties, and model factory overloads as obsolete. They remain callable with a service API version that supports Entra ID configuration.

Azure.ResourceManager.EventHubs_1.4.0-beta.2

1.4.0-beta.2 (2026-11-25)

Features Added

  • Added long-running namespace update overloads accepting WaitUntil for API version 2026-07-01-preview. Existing Update and UpdateAsync overloads remain supported and wait for completion.

Azure.ResourceManager.KeyVault_1.6.0-beta.1

1.6.0-beta.1 (2026-11-17)

Features Added

  • Upgraded the API version to 2026-10-01-preview.
  • Added network security perimeter configuration operations and models.
  • Added support for managed identities, token binding, cross-tenant access protection, and external protection-key wrapping.
